data.description: The Acres by Meraas – Luxury Villas in Dubailand | Limited Cancelled Units Available | 65/35 Payment Plan
data.long_description:
The Acres by Meraas in Dubailand was a complete sell-out, and now a limited number of cancelled units are back on the market, offering investors and end-users a rare second chance.

Featuring 3, 4, and 5-bedroom villas with private gardens, contemporary architecture, and resort-style amenities, The Acres combines modern luxury with lush green spaces.

With its prime Dubailand location and proven demand, securing one of these exclusive units is a unique opportunity to enter a high-growth, high-prestige community.
